chunks: And from him, from Al-Maqani, from Ja'far ibn Muhammad Al-Zuhri, from Ishaq ibn Mansur, from Qays ibn Rabi' and others, from Asim, from Zurr, from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: The world will not pass away until a man from my Ahl al-Bayt, who is called Al-Mahdi, takes charge of my Ummah.
ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet say about the condition of the world before the arrival of Al-Mahdi?
ai.summary: This narration from Abdullah ibn Mas'ud, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, underscores the inevitability of Imam Mahdi’s appearance as a definitive sign of the end times. It highlights the continuity of prophetic leadership through the Ahl al-Bayt, reinforcing the Shia belief that divine authority will be restored by a descendant of the Prophet named Al-Mahdi. The report serves as a foundational text for the doctrine of occultation and eventual reappearance.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 141 - It is narrated from Maqanai from Ja’far bin Muhammad Zuhri from Ishaq bin Mansur from Qays bin Rabi from Asim from Zarr from Abdullah bin Masud that he said:
The Messenger of Allah (s) said: The world would not end till a person from my Ahle Bayt (a.s), who is named as Mahdi, does not become the ruler and leader of my Ummah.
